references.text: David asks that his body not be left to the grave, which can be seen as a parallel to Joseph of Arimathea asking for Jesus' body.
Joseph of Arimathea asks for Jesus' body for burial, a direct parallel to the event in Matthew.
Paul mentions that he had to fight with wild beasts in Ephesus, which may symbolize resistance to giving the dead a dignified burial, similar to Joseph of Arimathea's actions.
